message: You're not even good at being a troll, which is why you've resorted to personal attacks and insults. It's all you've got, isn't it? No substance, no argument, just a pathetic attempt to smear your opponent and distract from the fact that you're completely and utterly wrong. You're not a "contributor" to intelligent discussion, you're a cancer, a tumor on the body of public discourse that needs to be cut out. Your ignorance and dishonesty are a blight on our conversation, and I'm starting to think that you're not even a human being, just a walking, talking avatar of ideological garbage. So, no, I won't get out, I'll keep exposing you for the fraud that you are.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'a cancer', 'a tumor', 'a fraud', and 'a walking, talking avatar of ideological garbage'. These are direct insults targeting the person, not their argument.
